# Skholar - Your Academic Companion

> Skholar is an AI-powered academic platform designed to help students with CBT practice, grade calculation, and study resources.

## Project Overview

- **Name**: Skholar (Lumora Project)
- **Purpose**: Academic utility app for students (focus on UNIBEN).
- **Core Features**:
  - **CBT Practice**: Computer Based Test simulation with real past questions.
  - **AI Chat**: Academic assistant powered by LLMs.
  - **GPA Calculator**: Tools for calculating semester and cumulative GPAs.
  - **Campus Map**: Digital map of the university campus.
  - **PDF Resources**: Library of academic materials.

## Key Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/Israel-Irene-Idemudia/uniben_project/blob/main/README.md): Setup and installation instructions.
- [API Documentation](/api/docs): Backend API endpoints (if public).

## For AI Agents

This project uses a Django backend (DRF) and a Flutter frontend. The codebase is structured as follows:

- `backend/uniben_project`: Django project root.
- `lib/`: Flutter source code.
- `lib/screens`: UI screens for mobile/web.
- `lib/services`: API integration services.
